Class Car

java.lang.Object
Car
public class Car extends Object
A car that can be parked in a parking slot. A car is identified by its registration number (one uppercase letter followed by five digits, e.g. "T12345"). It knows its owner, make, model, whether the owner is a staff member and the time at which it was parked. The class also calculates how long the car has been parked and the parking fee.

    • Car

      public Car(String regoNumber, String owner, String make, String model, boolean staffMember)
      Creates a car.
      Parameters:
      regoNumber - registration number, one capital letter followed by 5 digits
      owner - name of the owner (not empty)
      make - make of the car (not empty)

      staffMember - true if the owner is a staff member
